title: Interviewing Havana syndrome victims
place_text: Cuba, Russia, China, Austria, Germany, Switzerland, United States

tellings.quote:
>> Yeah. We've been interviewing victims of
Havana syndrome. Yeah.

plain: A team has been interviewing victims of Havana syndrome, the mysterious illness reported by American officials in Cuba and later in places such as Russia, China, Austria, Germany, Switzerland and the United States. Chris Gilbert says this in passing, speaking as one of the people doing the interviews, on an episode with Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency, America's electronic spying agency. He mentions it as part of their first-hand work on the cases.
